assets.title: Enakke theriyaama veettukku vandha nee.
assets.message: Nee oorukku poirundhappo namakkulla nalla sanda. Adhukku appuram seriya pesikkala. Nee dhoorama irukkuradhaala dhaan sanda vandhutte irukku, vandhadhum pesikkalaam-nu ninaichen. Aana nee sonna time-ku munnadiye vandhuttu, enakke theriyaama en veettukku vandhu surprise kudutha. Appo enakku gift-um kudutha. Andha moment-la naan second time clean bowled! Unna mattum life-la vittuda koodaadhu-nu ninaichen. 🥰🙁

letter: Epdi irukka... Idhu letter maadhiri irukkum-nu enakku theriyudhu. Aana naan evlo try panniyum ennaala unkitta pesa mudiyala. Unakku call panni paathen, message panni paathen, un friends mooliyama reach panna paathen, apram en friends mooliyama kooda try pannen. Ippadi edhu panniyum ennaala unna reach panna mudiyala...
Adhaan ippadi try panren... Nee yosikkalaam, 'Ennada ivan vidave maatraan?' nu...

Enakkum adhu dhaan theriyala... Naanum unna disturb panna koodaadhu-nu mind-a fix pannippen. Ovvoru thadavayum nee 'Enna vitturu' nu sollumbodhu yosippen... Aana 🥲 marubadiyum oru thadava try pannalaam-nu thonidum.
Enakku puriyudhu, unna suthi neraya prechana irukku. Idhula naanum unakku oru prechanaiya theriyuren-nu... Appadi unakku thonradhukku naanum kaaranam-nu ippo puriyudhu.
Unkitta eppavum sanda pottutte irundhirukken. Nee pesa stop panradhukku munnadi, kadaisiya sila vaati pesumbodhu solluva...
'Sanda poda dhaan ippo paaka vandhiya? Sanda poda dhaan call panniya? Ennaala sanda poda mudiyala...' nu. 🥲
Adha kekkumbodhu romba kashtama irukkum. Yen-na, naan normal-ah dhaan pesa vandhiruppen. Aana unakku appadi thonra alavukku naan nadandhukitten...
Mela nammaloda sila memories paathiruppa... Enakku unna maadhiri love kaatta theriyuma-nu theriyala. Aana naan unna avlo love panren. Adha sariyaa kaatta dhaan theriyala... ❤️

Oru naal Aaladipatiyan-la namma coffee kudichittu irukkumbodhu, unnoda family story-a full-ah sonna. Apram 'Yosichukkonga' nu sonna. Naanum konja neram amaidhiya irundhen. Neeyum adha purinjukittu, 'Process panreenga-nu puriyudhu... nalla time eduthukkonga' nu sonna.

En mind-la odinadhu... Indha maadhiri vishayam vera yaarukkaavadhu nadandhu, naan dhoorathula irundhu paathirukken. Aana ippo enakku pudicha ponnukku ivlo pain irukku-ngradha ennaala udane process panna mudiyala...

Aana adhukku appuram unna vittu poga koodaadhu-nu mudivu pannen. Enga amma, appa kittayum un pain pathi sonnen. Avangalukkum adha purinjukka konjam time aachu... avanga konjam old generation-la. Aana enga ammavukku en mela nambikkai irukku... en decision mela nambikkai irukku.
Enga ammavukku unna romba pudikkum... ❤️

Naan appo appo sollirukken-la... 'Family-la payan ready-ah-nu kekkuraanga' nu amma sonnadha. Neeyum kovappaduva. Aana ovvoru thadavayum amma enna summa kalaaikka dhaan keppaanga. Appo ellam naan unna pathi dhaan solluven. Avangalum 'Seri, time eduthuko' nu solliduvaanga.
Aana idhellam unkitta naan kaattikkala... Unkitta vilayaadradhu enakku pudikkum. Adhula en feelings-a serious-ah sollaama vittutten.
Most of the time, ennoda feelings-a admit pannaama adamant-ah irundhirukken. Adhu full and full-ah en thappu. Sorry di... 🙁
Nee appo appo solluva, 'Unakku ippo edhuvum thonaadhu... naan pona dhaan nee enna theduva' nu. Aana naan 'Enakku thedala' nu sonnen...
Yen-na, appo nee evlo dhoorama irundhaalum, en pakkathula irukkura maadhiri dhaan enna paathuppa. Aana ippo pakkathula dhaan irukka... irundhaalum romba dhoorama irukkura maadhiri irukku. 🥲
Unnoda kashtathula naan un kooda irukkanum-nu dhaan ninaichen. Unna vittu poganum-nu ennaikkum ninaichadhu illa...
Maybe unakku interest poirukkalaam... Aana en memory unakkulla konjamaavadhu irukkum-nu ninaikkiren.
Appo irundha andha ponnukku enna pudikkum... Ippo irukkura unakkum enna pudikkanum-nu aasa padren. Adhukku dhaan ivlo try panren...
People change constantly... Oru partner-ah, andha changes-aiyum serthu love pannanum-nu ippo puriyudhu.
Oruthanga marriage-kku appuram vera maadhiri iruppaanga, kuzhandhaikku appuram vera maadhiri iruppaanga, 40 vayasula vera maadhiri iruppaanga, 60 vayasula vera maadhiri iruppaanga...
Namma eppavum ore maadhiri irukkura aalai theda koodaadhu... Ovvoru thadavayum adhe person-oda different versions-a dhaan love panrom. Idha purinjukittaale paadhi prechana solve aagum-nu thonudhu.
Marubadiyum solren... Nee enna evlo hate pannalum, I still love you. Yen-na, naan avlo love unkitta irundhu vaangirukken. Now it's my turn... ❤️
littleNotes: I may have used too many hearts on this page. I ran out of better ways to draw what I feel.
Even the ordinary days with you became things I wanted to remember.
You do not have to find the right words today. I just wanted you to know you matter to me.
